what_makes_it_special: Hand-crafted interconnected world; minimal hand-holding rewards exploration and persistence.

mechanical_innovations.name: Charm system
mechanical_innovations.description: Equippable modifiers with notch budget enabling player-defined builds.

mechanical_innovations.name: Soul economy
mechanical_innovations.description: Combat generates resource for healing AND magic; spending requires a safe window.

emotional_impact: Lonely majesty; persistence converted into earned mastery.
design_lessons_applicable: Map purchase model (Cornifer) trains player observation.
Boss telegraphs paired with iframes create predictable danger.
Optional content (Path of Pain) extends ceiling without gating completion.
